caption:
One ordinary day under New York: 8,348 scheduled subway trains, all moving at once.

Watch the system wake before dawn, saturate at rush hour and thin out overnight — every dot is a real train, coloured by its line.

📊 See a full day on the New York City Subway in this animated flow map, built from the published MTA GTFS timetable for Thursday 3 September 2026, across 459 stations. Explore how Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens and the Bronx fill and empty over 24 hours.

Source: MTA New York City Subway GTFS, data.ny.gov. Positions are interpolated between the published stops; each train is coloured by its line in official MTA colours, grouped by trunk. The network is reconstructed from the sequence of stations.
